description: relay_client.rs calls stoa_core::util::nntp_dot_stuff to dot-stuff the SMTP DATA body. RFC 5321 §4.5.2 and RFC 3977 both specify the same dot-stuffing algorithm, so the reuse is correct. But without a comment, a reader who sees nntp_dot_stuff in an SMTP file will wonder if this is a mistake. The call site comment should say: RFC 5321 §4.5.2 specifies the same dot-stuffing as NNTP (RFC 3977 §3.1.1.1); the shared function is correct.
title: nntp_dot_stuff used in SMTP path without bridging comment
